title: 第0003章 不是仙人只是修仙者第0004章 进入宗门杂役弟子
slug: 五灵根修炼慢我有百倍灵药空间
content_zh:
;;
等了半天，再也没有人继续觉醒灵根。
白仙师对着老村长说道：“此次检测石村有四人有灵根，可进入仙门修炼。”
老村长连忙拜谢：“麻烦三位仙师了。”
白仙师手一挥，四百两白银出现在四人手中，对着四人吩咐：“给你们盏茶时间和你们家人道别，我们还要到下一个村落收人。”
石柔，王山，赵小五三人立刻找到自己的家人，将白银交给自己的家人。
只有陆青禾孤零零的站在原地。
看到陆青禾手中的白银，陆王氏顿时来了心思。
她走过来满脸贪婪的看着陆青禾手中的银子：“小兔崽子，我是你的婶婶，将银子交给我，我替你保管。”
陆青禾急忙的收起银子，警惕的看着泼妇。
陆王氏看陆青禾这样愤怒了：“小兔崽子，你反了天了？”
陆青禾看陆王氏要动手，急忙喊道：“毒妇，在仙师面前你敢抢我东西？”
陆青禾的话让陆王氏脸色一僵，她将目光看向三位仙师，看到三人正似笑非笑的看着她。
不知道为什么她心底瞬间不寒而栗，脸色讪讪不甘心的退了回去。
刚才的教训可是历历在目。
陆青禾想了一下，走到老村长面前，将白银交给老村长：“村长爷爷，多谢您这一年的照顾，这些是青禾对你的报答。”
要不是老村长，他断然不会有这样的机会了，这白银放在他这里他也带不走，还不如乘机报答老村长的恩情。
老村长脸色复杂的看着陆青禾，他没有想到陆青禾竟然真的被选中有进入仙门的机会。
老村长摇头拒绝：“不用了，我并没有做什么，你收好，哪怕进入仙门也用得上。”
陆青禾坚持道：“村长爷爷，没有你，我没有这样的机会，再说这么多银两我也带不走。”

看陆青禾态度坚决，老村长犹豫了一下，将银子接了过来：“那好，我替你保管，等需要的时候回来拿就行了。”
然后对着石柔交代：“小柔儿，以后到了仙宗，要多多青禾照顾。”
石柔满脸好奇的打量着陆青禾，随即点点头：“爷爷我会的。”
陆青禾露出童真的笑容：“多谢村长爷爷。”
陆青禾也不知道他这一去能不能回到这个地方。
他原本是想去祭拜祭拜父母，但是时间来不及了，只有等以后修仙有成再回来祭拜父母，告慰父母在天之灵。
时间差不多了，白仙师开口：“时间到了，现在我们要走了。”
白仙师拍了拍腰间的布袋，一艘巴掌大的小船出现在手中。
白仙师口中念念有词，打出一道法诀。
巴掌大的小船见风而长，很快的就长成一艘数米长的船帆。
不等四人说话，白仙师手一挥，四个灵根孩童就出现在船帆之内。
在众人的惊呼声之中，船帆飞天而起，消失在了天际之上。
等到船帆消失，老村长将目光看向陆王氏。
“陆王氏，将青禾那孩子的东西交回来，我暂时替他保管。”
content_en:
;;
After waiting for a long time, no one continued to awaken their spiritual roots.
Immortal Master Bai said to the old village chief: "In this test, four people in Shicun Village have spiritual roots and can enter the Immortal Sect to practice."
The old village chief quickly thanked: "I'm sorry to trouble you, the three immortal masters."
Master Bai Xian waved his hand, and four hundred taels of silver appeared in the hands of the four people. He told the four people: "I will give you tea time to say goodbye to your family. We have to go to the next village to collect people."
Shi Rou, Wang Shan, and Zhao Xiaowu immediately found their families and handed the silver to their families.
Only Lu Qinghe stood alone.
Seeing the silver in Lu Qinghe's hand, Lu Wang suddenly had thoughts.
She walked over and looked at the silver in Lu Qinghe's hand greedily: "Little bastard, I am your aunt. Give me the silver and I will keep it for you."
Lu Qinghe hurriedly put away the money and looked at the shrew warily.
Mrs. Lu Wang saw Lu Qinghe so angry: "Little bastard, have you rebelled?"
Seeing that Lu Wang was about to take action, Lu Qinghe hurriedly shouted: "Vicious woman, do you dare to rob me in front of the immortal master?"
Lu Qinghe's words made Lu Wang's face stiffen. She looked at the three immortal masters and saw them looking at her with half-smiles.
She didn't know why she suddenly shuddered in her heart, and she retreated with a stern expression on her face.
The lesson just learned is still vivid in my mind.
Lu Qinghe thought for a moment, walked up to the old village chief, and handed the silver to the old village chief: "Grandpa, village chief, thank you for your care this year. This is Qinghe's reward for you."
If it weren't for the old village chief, he definitely wouldn't have had such an opportunity. He couldn't take the silver with him, so he might as well take the opportunity to repay the old village chief's kindness.
The old village chief looked at Lu Qinghe with a complicated expression. He did not expect that Lu Qinghe would actually be chosen to have a chance to enter the Immortal Sect.
The old village chief shook his head and refused: "No, I didn't do anything. You should keep it. You will need it even when you enter the Immortal Sect."
Lu Qinghe insisted: "Grandpa, village chief, without you, I wouldn't have such an opportunity, and I wouldn't be able to take away so much silver."
Seeing Lu Qinghe's resolute attitude, the old village chief hesitated and took the money: "Okay, I'll keep it for you. Just come back and get it when you need it."
Then he told Shi Rou: "Xiao Rou'er, when you get to Xianzong from now on, you will need to be taken care of by Duoduo Qinghe."
Shi Rou looked at Lu Qinghe curiously, then nodded: "Grandpa, I can do it."
Lu Qinghe smiled innocently: "Thank you, Grandpa Village Chief."
Lu Qinghe didn't know if he could return to this place.
He originally wanted to go and pay homage to his parents, but he was too late. He had to wait until he succeeded in cultivating immortals before coming back to pay homage to his parents and comfort his parents' spirits in heaven.
The time was almost up, and Master Bai Xian said: "The time is up, we have to leave now."
Master Bai Xian patted the bag on his waist, and a palm-sized boat appeared in his hands.
Master Bai Xian muttered words and typed a spell.
The palm-sized boat grew in response to the wind, and soon grew into a sail several meters long.
Before the four of them could speak, Master Bai Xian waved his hand, and four children with spiritual roots appeared in the sail.
Amid everyone's exclamations, the sail flew into the sky and disappeared into the sky.
When the sail disappeared, the old village chief looked at Lu Wang.
"Ms. Lu Wang, please bring back the Qinghe child's belongings. I will keep them for him for the time being."
